quarterly_data.quarter: Ruijie Networks quarterly report: 2026 Q3 Report (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 Q3 report (unaudited): Q3 revenue RMB 5,763,880,050.43, up 42.98% year over year; Jan-Sep revenue RMB 14,595,755,014.82, up 36.66%, mainly on growth in data-center switch revenue. Net profit attributable to shareholders: Q3 RMB 386,837,755.08 (+69.43%), Jan-Sep RMB 1,081,031,923.64 (+58.87%); the company attributes the profit growth to accelerated delivery of internet customers' data-center switch orders and a lower expense ratio from management and efficiency improvements. Jan-Sep R&D expense RMB 1,743,007,237.34 (+31.26%), mainly higher R&D on data-center switches and other core products.

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 Q3 report balance sheet: inventories RMB 9,096,693,743.30 at September 30, 2026 versus RMB 2,960,039,230.73 at the start of the year (+207.32%), mainly from increased raw-material stocking and larger production scale; prepayments RMB 1,019,929,433.31 (+2195.10%), mainly raw-material purchase prepayments; construction in progress RMB 113,874,363.88 (none at the start of the year), mainly production-line expansion; contract liabilities RMB 707,579,614.86 (+32.05%) on more advance receipts. quarterly_data.signal: 2026 Q3 report: the board approved on September 18, 2026 a plan whose proceeds would fund R&D and industrialization of a high-speed interconnect network system for large-scale intelligent-computing clusters, R&D and industrialization of high-speed network switching units and overall solutions for high-density compute clusters, and a next-generation compute-network convergence key-technology R&D project; the plan still needs approval from the Fujian provincial SASAC, the shareholders' meeting, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange and CSRC registration (conditional).
